data.name: Kort
data.gender_notes: Kort is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German 'kurzt', meaning short. This name was often given to children who were considered small in stature but large in spirit. In the Bible, there are no references to a character named Kort. The name Kort carries the meaning “Short, bold” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kort usually hope their child will grow to embody short, bold and live with faith, good character and purpose.
